$comment: Which third-party licences may ship in the app, and the licence data no manifest provides. Read by scripts/build-third-party-licenses.mjs, scripts/copy-third-party-licenses.mjs and android/app/build.gradle. See licenses/README.md before changing anything here.

ical.js.reason: File-level copyleft only: it covers changes to ical.js's own files, which this app does not make. The package is used unmodified from npm, and its source is public.

net.zetetic:sqlcipher-android.reason: The POM names only https://www.zetetic.net/sqlcipher/license/, which is the BSD-3-Clause text of the Community Edition, and the AAR ships no licence file.

org.apache.cordova:framework.reason: Apache-2.0 requires passing on the NOTICE of the work; the AAR does not contain it. Taken from github.com/apache/cordova-android.

capacitor-swift-pm.reason: GitHub cannot classify LICENSE.md because of a sentence appended to the MIT text.

sqlcipher.swift.reason: LICENSE.md is the BSD-3-Clause text followed by the whole SQLite README, which GitHub cannot classify.
